name.x-prompt: What name would you like to use for the microservice?

transport.description: Default transport protocol written to .env.example / .env (auto-detected from apps/api/.env if omitted).

port.description: TCP port for the microservice (auto-incremented from existing microservices if omitted).

inspectPort.description: Node.js debugger/inspect port for nx serve (auto-incremented from existing microservices if omitted).

skipBff.description: Skip generating libs/<name>-client and wiring the service into apps/api.

withDb.description: Generate db.provider.ts and inject DBStrategy into the microservice.

withDocker.description: Generate Dockerfile.ms-<name> at the workspace root.

tags.description: Comma-separated extra Nx tags to append to default tags (type:microservice, scope:<name>).
